preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**12 for x in x_list)
preconditions.description: Each vertex beauty is a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^12.
The tree has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range.
The input edges form a connected acyclic graph (tree) rooted at vertex 1.

postconditions.expression: result == sum(gcd_path(u, v) for u in ancestors(v) for v in range(1, n + 1)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the GCDs of beauties along all paths where u is an ancestor of v, modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: gcd_path(u, v) == gcd([x_list[t - 1] for t in path(u, v)])
postconditions.description: For any ancestor u of v, the beauty of the path f(u, v) is the GCD of beauties of vertices on the path from u to v.
